normalization_amendment.boundary: Real native collector first; all closed builtin tuples become fresh lists, not only node/edge rows. This representation conversion is followed by unchanged dynamic field/schema guards; no native authority is minted from JSON.
normalization_amendment.resource_keys: Only conditional model resources: homogeneous exact nonnegative int or canonical ASCII decimal str keys, matching exact integer node identity. All mixed key types, including noncolliding pairs, are rejected.
normalization_amendment.failure_contract: Closed predictor is not restarted; all18 rows retained. Every available lifecycle clock is exact nonnegative int; missing-raw failures retain validated branch attempt clocks distinct from unknown root time. Aborted cleanup never becomes valid CLOSED.
